summary: The recorded base reproduced the missing eight-draft-pool budget term. The exact candidate passed its complete focused suite and an independent 26,415-case page-boundary and hybrid-geometry sweep. Its Python correction accounts for the allocator's widened virtual span, including the extra page, and covers MXFP8-like data-plus-scale bytes. Acceptance is recommended for the source-level sizing fix, while the unavailable B300/CUDA/TP8/Inkling integration remains unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: the base selected a capacity requiring 72456601600 bytes including eight allocator-sized draft pools from 70276402380 available bytes; 1 failed and 2 passed.
All 44 pool-configurator tests and 7 subtests passed, including eight draft pools, page padding, fixed SWA caps, ordinary draft-SWA capacity, and MXFP8 scale-byte geometry.
Independent exhaustive check of 26415 satisfiable configurations; each returned allocation fit the budget and adding one full-token page exceeded it.
Confirmed checkout source paths, PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, one AMD Instinct MI350X, and a basic GPU matrix operation. This was environment evidence, not proof of the CUDA/B300 serving path.

gpu_execution_evidence: reports/j-a5e70d53efc5/raw/gpu_environment.log records execution on one AMD Instinct MI350X with ROCm 7.2; no NVIDIA B300 execution occurred.
remaining_counterexamples: The exact 8x NVIDIA B300, CUDA 13, TP8, Inkling-NVFP4, eight-draft-pool startup sequence remains unexecuted because the prepared environment has one AMD Instinct MI350X and no Inkling model weights.
Architecture-specific CUDA allocation, FP4 kernel, distributed TP8, serving startup, and semantic behavior remain unverified; the deterministic sizing evidence cannot qualify those paths.
remaining_limitations: The prepared environment is ROCm 7.2 on one AMD Instinct MI350X, not CUDA 13 on eight NVIDIA B300 GPUs.
Inkling-NVFP4 model weights were unavailable, so no model startup or request was run.
No native source changed in the candidate, so a native rebuild was not applicable.

fully_resolves_original is false solely because the issue's exact architecture-specific integration reproduction was unavailable; the platform-independent allocation contract was independently verified.
